title: fix(fields): "is empty" / "is not empty" write a filter shape objectstack accepts (objectui#10790)
body:
Fixes #10790
Clause-②: no — the widget starts writing a shape its bound contract already accepts; no declared surface moves (confirmed from the diff at review)

## What changed

`FilterConditionField` (`packages/fields/src/widgets/FilterConditionField.tsx`), the `filter-condition` widget behind `relatedListFilter`, a roll-up's `summaryOperations.filter` and `sys_sharing_rule.criteria_json`:

- **Writer (`condToMongo`).** "Is empty" and "Is not empty" no longer store a `null` list member.

  | operator | before | after |
  |:--|:--|:--|
  | "Is empty" | `{ FIELD: { $in: [null, ''] } }` | `{ $or: [{ FIELD: { $in: [''] } }, { FIELD: { $null: true } }] }` |
  | "Is not empty" | `{ FIELD: { $nin: [null, ''] } }` | `{ FIELD: { $nin: [''], $null: false } }` |

  The meaning does not change: no value OR the empty string, and its complement. Every other operator arm is byte-identical.
- **Reader (`kvToCondition`, `mongoToFilterGroup`).** "Is empty" is now one stored entry whose key is `$or`, not the field. `kvToCondition` reads exactly that entry back as one `is_empty` row, and returns `null` for every other `$` key (its callers already refused them). The two-operator `{ $nin: [''], $null: false }` reads back as `is_not_empty`. The old `[null, '']` arms stay, so stored rules keep opening.
- `filterGroupToMongo` is unchanged. An AND group merges the `$or` entry beside field keys. Two "is empty" rows collide on `$or` and fall to the `$and` form, like any two rows on one key.
- No export is added or removed.
- Pins: a new `FilterConditionField.emptyOperators-10790.test.tsx`, plus the old-shape cells in `FilterConditionField.operators.test.ts` and in the app-shell census `filter-builder-protocol-ids-census-9306.test.ts` (its `mongo` column for these two ids; a second named exception is added to its header). `operatorsOf` in the operators test now descends into `$or` / `$and`, so the spec-spelling sweep still judges the operators inside the "is empty" entry.
- One changeset, `'@object-ui/fields': patch`.

## H1 — reproduced on `main` (`dac022c4e4`)

Driven through the real widget and the real FilterBuilder dropdowns, one column per offered type. Each written value was run through `assertListComparandShapes` from the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0. This was a one-off probe with the base `FilterConditionField.tsx` in place; the file was restored by blob hash, and the probe was not committed.

| type | "Is empty" written | "Is not empty" written | `equals` (control) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| text | `{"name":{"$in":[null,""]}}` | `{"name":{"$nin":[null,""]}}` | `{"name":""}`, accepted |
| number | `{"amount":{"$in":[null,""]}}` | `{"amount":{"$nin":[null,""]}}` | `{"amount":""}`, accepted |
| date | `{"due_on":{"$in":[null,""]}}` | `{"due_on":{"$nin":[null,""]}}` | `{"due_on":""}`, accepted |
| select | `{"stage":{"$in":[null,""]}}` | `{"stage":{"$nin":[null,""]}}` | `{"stage":""}`, accepted |
| lookup | `{"account":{"$in":[null,""]}}` | `{"account":{"$nin":[null,""]}}` | `{"account":""}`, accepted |

Each of the ten operator rows is refused with `code=INVALID_FILTER status=400`. The text row's refusal, verbatim:

```text
Operator "$in" on field "name" does not accept null as a list member (at where.name.$in[0]). No two backends agree on what it matches; state absence explicitly with the null predicate: {"$or": [{"name": {"$in": […]}}, {"name": {"$null": true}}]} is "one of […] OR has no value"; {"$null": false} is "has a value". Authoring spellings: in. The filter was NOT applied, and an unapplied filter would have returned the UNFILTERED result set.
```

The `$nin` rows print the same sentence with `"$nin"`, `$nin[0]` and `Authoring spellings: nin, not_in, notin`.

With the fix, the same probe writes `{"$or":[{"name":{"$in":[""]}},{"name":{"$null":true}}]}` and `{"name":{"$nin":[""],"$null":false}}` (and the same for each type), and the face accepts all ten.

## H2 — the accepted spelling

Source: objectstack-ai/objectstack PR #20247 at its head `ab146a9a3f` (merged since, 2026-09-27T16:14Z, as `cfc3bcf15f`), in `packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts`, the builder `nullListComparandMemberMessage`. Cited by symbol, not by line (this repo's AGENTS.md #11). This is the save-door text `FilterConditionSchema` prints at #20247's head for `{ name: { $in: [null, ''] } }`, at path `name.$in.0`, verbatim:

```text
null is not a valid $in member at index 0. No two backends agree on what a null in a list-comparand position matches (the SQL family answers a NULL under NOT IN unconditionally; the JS matchers split over the two readings of "no value"). State absence explicitly with the null predicate instead: {"$or": [{"$in": […]}, {"$null": true}]} is "one of […] OR has no value", and {"$null": false} is the has-a-value half. Ruled 2026-08-31: a null list member is refused at the validation entrance.
```

For `$nin: [null, '']` it prints the same sentence with `$nin`, at `name.$nin.0`.

- **"Is empty"** is the prescription applied to `[null, '']`: `$or` of `$in` with the non-null member `['']`, and `$null: true`.
- **"Is not empty"** uses the prescription's complement form, not `$ne: null` AND `$ne: ''`. The has-a-value half the prescription names (`$null: false`) is combined with the De Morgan complement of `$in: ['']`, which is `$nin: ['']`, on one field key. This mirrors the prescription's own operators. Keeping one field key keeps the flat group merge and the read-back one arm.
- **The faces accept both shapes. Measured, not only read:**

  | shape | installed spec 17.4.0: face / `FilterConditionSchema` | #20247 head: face / `FilterConditionSchema` |
  |:--|:--|:--|
  | old "is empty" | REFUSE 400 / success | REFUSE 400 / refused at `name.$in.0` |
  | old "is not empty" | REFUSE 400 / success | REFUSE 400 / refused at `name.$nin.0` |
  | new "is empty" | accept / success | accept / success |
  | new "is not empty" | accept / success | accept / success |
  | new "is empty" inside `$and` beside a field | accept / success | accept / success |

  The head column was run from `packages/spec/src` extracted at `ab146a9a3f` under `tsx`, against zod 4.4.3 (the head declares `^4.6.1`; the version gap is stated, not measured away). The prescription and the schema agree, so there is no `needs_decision`.
- **The objectui read path also accepts the new shapes.** `toFilterNodeSafely` and `mergeFilterNodes` (the path `RelatedList` sends a `relatedListFilter` down) lower them to `["or",["name","in",[""]],["name","is_null",true]]` and `["and",["name","nin",[""]],["name","is_not_null",true]]`. The installed spec's `parseFilterAST` plus the face accept both, merged with a parent scope. The old shape lowers, and is then refused (`INVALID_FILTER` / 400).

## H3 — the reader

- **Before:** `kvToCondition` mapped `$in: [null, '']` to `is_empty` and `$nin: [null, '']` to `is_not_empty`. `mongoToFilterGroup` refused every `$` key that was not a lone top-level `$and` / `$or` (the widget dropped to raw JSON).
- **After:** the old arms are kept. The new "is empty" entry reads as one row wherever a row can stand:
  - alone (a lone `$or` is no longer read as an OR group of its two halves);
  - merged beside field keys in an AND group;
  - inside `$and` / `$or` arrays.

  The new "is not empty" reads through a two-operator arm. Only the exact entry the builder writes is folded. The same predicate in another order stays the OR group it is (pinned as a control).
- **No rewrite on read alone.** Opening either old shape (and either new one) calls `onChange` zero times. The form therefore holds the bytes it loaded.
- **Does an old rule re-save in the new shape?** Yes, once any row of it is edited in the builder. The widget re-emits the whole criteria, so the untouched old "is empty" / "is not empty" row is written in the new shape (pinned: editing a neighbouring row writes `{"$or":[…],"amount":6}`). Opened and saved with no builder edit, it keeps its old bytes, because the widget emits nothing.

## Pins, red on base, and the ablation

`FilterConditionField.emptyOperators-10790.test.tsx`, 25 tests:

- **WRITER.** "Is empty" and "Is not empty" on each of text / number / date / select / lookup: 10 rows. Each asserts the exact bytes, then asserts `assertListComparandShapes` does not throw and `FilterConditionSchema.safeParse` succeeds. Five `equals` control rows use the same harness and the same faces.
- **READER.** The old and new shape of each operator opens as one row, with no emission: 4 rows.
- **RE-SAVE:** 2 rows.
- **GROUPS.** AND-merged, the `$and` form, the OR group, and the other-order control: 4 rows.

**Red on base.** The pins ran with the base `FilterConditionField.tsx` (blob `e93dd866a0`, equal to `dac022c4e4`'s) in the committed tree `14e75acc42`, and the file was restored by blob hash with `git diff HEAD` empty.

- `emptyOperators-10790`: 17 of 25 failed. That is the 10 writer rows, the 2 new-shape reader rows, the 2 re-save rows and 3 group rows. Green: the 5 `equals` controls, the 2 old-shape reader rows and the other-order control.
- `operators.test`: 1 of 63 failed (the value-less-operators pin).
- census: 2 of 132 failed (`is_empty` / `is_not_empty` in the `mongo` column).
- Total: 20 failed, 200 passed.

**Green on head `5818451b90`:** the same three files pass 220 of 220.

**Ablation (one-off, no permanent file).** `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (objectstack) in WRAP mode, from the committed `5818451b90`. It restores the two old writer arms in `condToMongo`. The anchor hit 1, went from x1 to x0, and the replacement went from x0 to x1. The blob went `fa87fd2451` → `69b678376a`, and the restore was proven by blob equal to HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty.

- Result: 17 failed, 203 passed, over the same three files. The failures were `emptyOperators-10790` 14 of 25, `operators.test` 1, and census 2.
- **Writer rows only.** Red: the 10 writer rows, the 2 re-save rows and the 2 group rows that assert an emission (AND-merged, OR re-write). Green: every reader row (old and new shape), the `$and`-form reader, the other-order control, the 5 `equals` controls and every census read-back cell.
- The predicted direction (red) was observed.
- The same red set was measured on `14e75acc42` before the typing refactor.

## Gates

Every row below is at `5818451b90` unless marked otherwise. Heavy runs went through `os-verify-lock.sh`.

| gate | reading |
|:--|:--|
| widget family + census + the 3 fields registry tests that render the widget (`vitest run`, 26 files) | `Test Files 26 passed (26)`, `Tests 701 passed (701)`, VERDICT command-exit 0 |
| `@object-ui/fields` `type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), after building the `@object-ui/fields^...` closure | exit 0. `--listFiles` counts the new test file in the test program |
| eslint on the 4 touched `.ts` / `.tsx` files (`--format json`) | 4 files, 0 errors, 50 warnings (pre-existing classes; the new helpers add no `any`) |
| `check:control-bytes` | exit 0, `OK (scanned 8989 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary)` |
| `check:new-line-citations` | exit 0, `0 new citation(s)` |
| `check-changeset-presence.mjs` | exit 0, 1 changeset added |
| `check:changeset-claims` / `check:pending-changeset-literals` / `check:test-path-roots` | exit 0 each |
| `@object-ui/fields` whole package (`vitest run packages/fields/`), at `14e75acc42` | `Test Files 215 passed / 1 skipped (216)`, `Tests 3478 passed / 7 skipped (3485)`. `5818451b90` only retypes the entry reader's helpers on `unknown`; the 26-file set above re-ran on it |

- **Lint narrowing, proven.**
  - The population is the four `.ts` / `.tsx` files this diff touches; the fifth file is the changeset `.md`.
  - The count, 4, is read from eslint's JSON output. No file was reported as ignored.
  - Invariance: `eslint.config.js` extends `tseslint.configs.recommended`, not a type-checked set, and has no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`. No rule under `eslint-rules/` reads another file. So no untouched file's verdict can move with this diff.
- **NOT MEASURED.**
  - `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check`. Reason: the census edit changes only `unknown`-typed literal cells and header prose; declared to CI.
  - The `apps/console` / `plugin-detail` tests that render the widget generically. Reason: they render it with no `object_name`, the state this diff does not touch; declared to CI.
  - Repo-wide `pnpm lint`. That run belongs to CI.

## Serial

- `git merge-tree --write-tree` of this head against a fresh `origin/main` (`13220af93f`) exits 0 with no conflicts.
- No path this PR touches moved on `main` between `dac022c4e4` and `13220af93f`.
- The PM's read of open PRs touching `FilterConditionField.tsx` was taken at 15:25Z.

## Acceptance notes

- **Old rules re-save in the new shape once edited.** Not on open alone (see H3). A rule nobody opens and edits keeps the refused shape. Since objectstack-ai/objectstack PR #20247 landed (merged 2026-09-27T16:14Z, `cfc3bcf15f`), a Studio save of such a `relatedListFilter` / `summaryOperations.filter` answers 422, with the prescription, until one of its rows is edited.
- **The sharing-rule binding (`sys_sharing_rule.criteria_json`). Read from objectstack `main` source; not run. `plugin-sharing` was not touched.**
  - The save path runs only the match-all guard (`bindRuleCriteriaGuard` → `isMatchAllCriteria`). The old shape is not match-all, so it saves.
  - Evaluation: `SharingRuleService.findMatchingRows` and `matchRecord` call `engine.find(object, { filter })`. The `filter` alias folds into `where`, and the engine calls `assertListComparandShapes` on it, which throws `INVALID_FILTER` / 400.
  - The service catches that, logs `[sharing-rule] criteria query failed`, and answers `[]` / `null`.
  - So a rule authored with the old shape shares nothing and revokes its grants (fail-closed), with only a server log line to show it. The new shapes pass the same face.
  - `matchRecord` spreads `{ ...criteria, id }`, which composes with a top-level `$or` / `$and` entry.
- **The `automation.rollup-summary-filter` item's missing step** (objectstack `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/automation.json`, P1). Its steps read the showcase's server-authored roll-ups, and its visual-editor step edits "the child-row filter" without naming an operator. No step authors "Is empty" / "Is not empty" through this builder.
  - The missing step: in Studio's visual filter editor on the duplicated package, author a child-row filter with "Is empty" (and one with "Is not empty") and save.
  - Then read the persisted `summaryOperations.filter` over the meta API and confirm it carries no `null` list member.
  - Then confirm the roll-up recomputes over child rows whose field is null, `''` and filled.
  - Not edited here (objectstack repo, outside this file surface).
- **The local flat `BuilderGroup` copy in app-shell** (`datasetFilterCondition.ts`, the `dataset.filter` bridge) does not write these arms. It stores "is empty" / "is not empty" as `$exists: false` / `$exists: true`, with no list member. It was not touched.
- **The spec's own authoring vocabulary means something narrower by `is_empty`.** In `@objectstack/spec`'s `filter.zod.ts`, `AST_OPERATOR_MAP` and the infix lowering map `is_empty` / `is_not_empty` to `$null` (null only), while this widget, per the triage ruling, keeps "no value OR `''`". This PR does not move either. The divergence is recorded in the report for the PM.
- **Not measured:** how the `''` half behaves on a typed column (number, date, lookup) on each SQL backend. The old shape carried the same `''` member, so this PR does not change it.
